subject.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes

question: Which Skill Workshop update writes should be allowed to bypass Gateway approval under the default `auto` policy?
rationale: The safe boundary is a product/trust decision: the current zero-overlap heuristic is bypassable, while requiring approval for all updates would intentionally narrow the recently landed automatic workflow.

options.title: Approve every update write
options.body: Keep create/reject/quarantine automatic but require explicit approval before any existing `SKILL.md` replacement, eliminating heuristic bypasses at the cost of one prompt per update.

options.title: Define a robust replacement signal
options.body: Keep ordinary updates automatic only after maintainers approve an explicit replacement-intent contract or a tested substantial-change rule that incidental copied lines cannot bypass.

options.title: Accept zero-overlap gating
options.body: Merge the current heuristic and explicitly accept that plan bodies sharing one existing line can still bypass approval.

recommendation.title: Approve every update write
recommendation.body: Keep create/reject/quarantine automatic but require explicit approval before any existing `SKILL.md` replacement, eliminating heuristic bypasses at the cost of one prompt per update.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision directly modifies the automatic-approval policy they introduced and landed.
